BASIS FOR THE ATTESTATION, stated so it is auditable: (1) the C6 blocker named by the charter — 8 residual-identified DOF entries in the keeper ledger — is retired to 6 by MEASURED REPLACEMENT, not by re-labeling: coal_perplant_offer_level reprices every CAMPD coal committed/econ tranche onto its own plant's merged modal 60-Day SCED Submitted TPO curve (verbatim disclosure conduct, zero fitted parameters, frozen derive scripts/data/derive_coal_perplant_offer.py), replacing the COAL_* offer_curve_by_group multipliers (25 scalars, STRIPPED from this run's config) and the COAL_SIGMOID_DEFAULTS[ERCOT] gas-keyed sigmoids (disarmed) — the largest fitted surface in the audit's class-C table (C-1); coal_take_or_pay_tranches is retired as a CAMPD-config false positive (the ScenarioConfig.coal_tranche_* fields are consumed only by the legacy split_coal_tranches path, dead code under use_campd_bins — the builder's C-12 precedent). (2) Every structural lever in this run traces to a measured/published input: coal mustrun = ERCOT-137 measured margin, coal mid-band = ERCOT-144 per-plant measured curves, coal peak = ERCOT-140 measured gas-parity margin, CC committed = ERCOT-139 measured level, gas margin/cleared-share surfaces = measured SCED/DAM conduct, availability = measured DAM envelope, outages = historic CAMPD windows (exogenous), fuel = F923/EP measured. (3) The remaining 6 residual entries are the rule-1-sanctioned offer-curve scope shared by every CALIBRATED keeper (offer_curve_by_group gas bands, smoothing shape) plus wefor pair / battery adder / merchant-CHP share, each carrying its open root-cause issue in this ledger (audit_keepers E8) — the same profile under which CAISO/PJM/MISO/NYISO/NEISO attest C6.
